title: Malaria deaths worldwide
definition: WHO's estimate of the number of people who died from malaria each year, all ages.

source.name: World Health Organization, Global Health Observatory, with minor processing by Our World in Data
source.version: OWID indicator 1242319, WHO GHO 2026, last updated 2026-05-22
source.license: WHO terms for data (reuse for public-health purposes, with attribution; not for promoting a commercial enterprise); WHO materials CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO
source.citation: World Health Organization – Global Health Observatory (2026) – with minor processing by Our World in Data. “Estimated number of malaria deaths – WHO” [dataset]. Accessed 2026-11-15.

notes: These are model estimates and carry uncertainty; only the central estimate is shown. Estimated deaths rose in 2020 and have stayed above the 2019 level since.
